questions.q: In the complete walkthrough, what does Marcus confirm when processing Dana's approved requisition line into a purchase order?
options: The supplier site, payment terms, and the match approval level
The requester's home address
The General Ledger chart of accounts structure
The receiving clerk's work schedule
questions.explain: Building the purchase order, Marcus confirms supplier-facing details like supplier site, payment terms (Net 30), and the match approval level (3-way).

questions.q: What happens the instant Priya's receipt for the 50 bearings is accepted?
options: Nothing happens until the invoice arrives
Receipt Accounting creates a journal debiting the maintenance expense account and crediting an uninvoiced receipts accrual account
The purchase order is automatically cancelled
Cash is immediately paid to Meridian
questions.explain: Receipt acceptance triggers the on-receipt accrual journal, recognizing the liability before any invoice exists.

questions.q: What kind of matching does Chen perform against Meridian's invoice in this walkthrough?
options: 2-way matching, against the purchase order only
4-way matching, against a separate acceptance document
3-way matching, against both the purchase order and the receipt
No matching is performed at all
questions.explain: The purchase order was set to require 3-way matching, checking the invoice against both the purchase order and Priya's receipt.

questions.q: What is the correct order of the three accounting journals created across this transaction?
options: Payment, then invoice accounting, then receipt accrual
All three journals are created simultaneously at requisition submission
Invoice accounting, then payment, then receipt accrual
Receipt accrual, then invoice accounting, then payment
questions.explain: The receipt accrual comes first (at receiving), followed by invoice accounting (clearing the accrual into AP), followed by the payment journal (clearing AP into cash).

questions.q: What is the final status of LTV's bearing purchase order once receiving and invoicing are both complete?
options: Cancelled
Pending Approval
Finally Closed
Open, indefinitely
questions.explain: Once all receiving and invoicing activity completes, the purchase order progresses through Closed for Receiving and Closed for Invoicing to Finally Closed.
